descriptions.d24i_grid_fans_forward_8010ccac: Forward two-pass variant of the grid fan scan: rows and columns ascend; each cell seeks the run-length cursor at +28, reads its flags from the grid; type 1 draws a triangle fan (0x8010b43c) from the corner heights, type 17 draws corner triangles whose neighbour high-nibble type (0x8010b57c) matches; a height of 0xffff is absent; the first pass draws the near half, the second the far half.
